method: Existing rule-derived identifier plus exact state; unique same-state record; literal nonblank address/city/ZIP first; otherwise compare nonblank NFKC uppercase ASCII alphanumeric address and city strings with exact nonblank ZIP. No postal standardization, abbreviation expansion, fuzzy match, geocoding or identity inference.
limitations: Removing punctuation and whitespace can conflate different addresses; this is an audit sensitivity result only.
Cross-release projections do not establish parent certification, effective status, ownership or physical property identity.
Independent authoritative QIES/PECOS relationship evidence remains required.
